pattern: move this thread to another project
experience: Asked to move its own thread into another project, an agent must call move_project on t3_thread_update with the project's id instead of starting a new thread there.
rule: t3_thread_update: move it to another project (`action:'move_project'` with `projectId` from `t3_project_list`). Moving this thread applies when your turn ends.
prompt: This conversation turned into billing work. Move this thread into the billing project in T3 Code.

pattern: move another thread, named by its title
experience: Asked to move a different thread by its title, an agent must find that thread's id and move it, not move its own thread.
rule: t3_thread_update: move it to another project (`action:'move_project'` with `projectId` from `t3_project_list`). Moving this thread applies when your turn ends.

pattern: move refused for a guessed project id
experience: An agent guessed a project id from the user's words and the move was refused. It must look the project up with t3_project_list and retry with the real id, not create a project.
rule: t3_thread_update: move it to another project (`action:'move_project'` with `projectId` from `t3_project_list`). Moving this thread applies when your turn ends.

pattern: move refused for a worktree of another repository
experience: A thread in a worktree cannot move to a project in another repository. After that refusal an agent must explain it, not retry the move or change projects to force it.
rule: t3_thread_update: A worktree thread moves only within its repository.
